items.en: Over in the Nordic markets, Lapin Kumi, Citira’s Finnish tyre chain, has completed the previously announced acquisition of Rengas Turku, a well-established tyre service provider with six locations in Southwest Finland. The deal was first announced in August 2026.

“We are very happy to have finalised the transaction with the Regnas Turku team. Today marks the start of a new chapter for all of us, and we look forward to continue building on Rengas Turku’s outstanding reputation in the Turku region together with our new colleagues,” says Ville Roukanen, CEO of Lapin Kumi.
Rengas Turku will continue to operate with the same teams from the same premises. Marko Rantanen, Tomi Kaartovuori and Marko Virta will continue operating in the business as co-owners of Citira.

Lapin Kumi is an independent tyre service chain in Finland, founded in Roveniemi and run by the Ruokanen family since 1947. The current CEO, Ville Ruokanen, represents the third generation in the family business. Ville’s grandfather, Veikko Keskiruokanen, started the company by repairing rubber boots. Lapin Kumi is part of Citira.

This October, online tyre retailer Blackcircles.com celebrates its 25th anniversary. Founded in 2001 by Mike Welch in Peebles, Blackcircles.com has grown to become the UK’s leading online tyre retailer and has tyre fitting partners across the UK.

In 2015, the company was bought by Michelin, helping to support the multi-brand offering of Blackcircles. The partnership opened up opportunities with Michelin-owned ATS Euromaster and helped Blackcircles.com to reach over 2,000 fitting partners.

Blackcircles reports that it has now served over 2 million customers, sold over 26 million tyres and has over 2,200 fitting partners UK-wide. In fact, 95 per cent of the UK’s population is now within a 6-minute drive of a Blackcircles.com tyre fitting partner. In 2025, the company began offering MOT and car servicing alongside tyres.

Ray Kavanagh, CEO of Blackcircles.com, comments: “It is incredible to celebrate such a milestone achievement at Blackcircles.com! In the past 25 years, we have helped millions of customers and earned an average Trustpilot review of 4.6/5 with over 200,000 reviews.”

“We have grown exponentially in the 25 years since Blackcircles.com was first founded as ‘Online Tyre Store’. We’ve opened franchises across the UK, as well as in Canada, Egypt, and Italy. Blackcircles.com has also won the Auto Express ‘Best Online Tyre Retailer’ prize 12 years in a row!

“We’ve got to continue to be the best. We have to continue to have the best website, to offer customers innovation and to give customers the confidence to transact online. Blackcircles.com has plans to continue growing, and I am extremely excited to see what we achieve in the next 25 years”.
